findings.evidence: Lines 134–143 prove `(adjointSO B hB).ker = LieAlgebra.center R L` and injectivity iff that centre is bottom.
findings.fix: Replace every unconditional “embedding”/“embeds” claim with “homomorphism” or “adjoint map”; reserve “embedding” for an explicitly injective specialization.
findings.issue: The module title and lines 32, 114, 132, and 181 call `adjointSO`/`killingAdjointSO` an embedding, although `ker_adjointSO` shows its kernel is the centre and no trivial-centre hypothesis is assumed.

findings.evidence: `killingQuadraticForm_nondegenerate` at lines 172–179 assumes both `[Invertible (2 : R)]` and `[LieAlgebra.IsKilling R L]` and proves only the forward implication.
findings.fix: Qualify the claim by requiring invertibility of `2`, and avoid “exactly” unless the converse is also stated or cited.
findings.issue: The `killingQuadraticForm` docstring says it is nondegenerate exactly in the Killing-semisimple case, but the cited theorem only establishes nondegeneracy with the additional `[Invertible (2 : R)]` hypothesis.

findings.evidence: The module’s Main results section names this theorem at lines 50–51, while line 141 begins the declaration without a preceding doc comment.
findings.fix: Add a docstring directly above `adjointSO_injective_iff` describing the equivalence between injectivity and trivial centre.
findings.issue: `adjointSO_injective_iff` is an advertised main theorem but has no declaration docstring; the preceding docstring attaches only to `ker_adjointSO`.

summary: Several docstrings overstate injectivity or nondegeneracy, and one advertised main theorem lacks its own documentation.
